method.build: Four original full runs alternate baseline, candidate, baseline, candidate on CPUs 12-15.
method.query: Separate four runs on CPU 13 compare equal-key build-only binary to final binary; all query outputs checked. Each phase warms 500 queries and measures three groups of 500, plus independent LIMIT groups of 5000 with 5000 warmup.
method.cpu: Whole private server process utime+stime from /proc, including background threads. 100 Hz ticks imply 0.02 ms/query quantization at 500 iterations and 0.002 at 5000. Shared host remains unisolated.

profiling.note: Qualitative debugger snapshots: selected hot threads and all-stop perturbation bias the samples; do not interpret inclusive counts as CPU percentages. All three profiled ALTER statements completed successfully. Finite workload is retained.

visible_differential.note: Same persisted indexes/data. SQL exposes full unrounded scores and IDs; comparison is exact client output, including row order. Native PS protocol is not used.

collation_differential.note: Extracted baseline/candidate comparison bodies and helpers, actual case table and full original general_ci state flags; both end-space modes and exact return integers checked.

notes: All new final goldens were recorded on the unchanged bc689eb binary. Existing tests and expected files were not changed.

Three initial new-fixture failures (long input, unsupported utf16 charset, binary prepared parameter) are preserved, not counted as passing; the final fixture uses supported inputs with explicit UTF-8 parameter conversion.
Extra native mysqltest --ps-protocol was not rerun and its previously reproduced old/new failure is not counted as passing. Ordinary protocol SQL PREPARE/EXECUTE is covered.

Earlier collation harness linking failure is preserved; final minimal harness extracts both comparison bodies/helpers verbatim, uses the actual Unicode table and exact state flags, and checks both end-space options.

limitations: Only two full runs per version, shared host; no platform score prediction or attribution to platform baseline.
SELECT 1 and untouched tokenizer paths can shift between runs; all negative and inconclusive observations are retained.
Runtime identity is the explicit binary path, SHA-256 and recorded patch; dirty working-tree report HEAD alone does not identify the running binary.
